shows.description: As we celebrate 50 years, we honor everyone who has worn the jersey, supported the club, and helped build its legacy. From the original Escondido Rugby Club to today's North County Gurkhas, the spirit remains the same: play hard, build lifelong friendships, serve our community, and carry the tradition forward. It's time to ROCK the month of October!! For our "RocktoberFest" theme this Friday we'll lean a little harder into the rockier side our Atomic Groove Variety Dance Band playlist, tho we will, of course, GROOVE-tober, as well! AG will be hosting another benefit, this one for local sports organization North County Gurkhas Rugby. They're celebrating 50 years of serving the community by creating opportunity for people to belong, grow, and serve through the game of rugby. Wear some rockstar garb, a rugby shirt and/or some Gurkhas team blue and bring your crew! We'll feature our AG guest vocalist, the soulful rocker Mark Jones and Performer Studentz from the Carrie Weiland Fitness/AG Fly Girlz Dance Class will rock the stage for a few songs.
